records.locator: Portuguese BPHS CP1252 lines2323–2327; external Sanskrit Chapter26 verse10
records.source_paraphrase: Saturn's special aspect strength depends on degrees passed/remain in the first and ninth sign intervals and distinct adjustments in the second and eighth intervals. The rule supplies source-specific reinforced strengths near the 3rd/10th aspects.
records.source_layer: Secondhand Portuguese translated verse, original Sanskrit electronically transcribed in BPHS 26.10
critical_limits: Sanskrit sign-interval indexing and boundary convention must be declared.
The strength in virūpas is an input to astrology's own formalism, not empirical evidence of harm or benefit.
No claims for people without a fully frozen method.

records.locator: Portuguese BPHS CP1252 lines2331–2335; external Sanskrit Chapter26 verse11
records.source_paraphrase: Mars gets strengthened aspects in three- and seven-sign difference cases, a distinct calculation in the two-sign case, and a full aspect in the six-sign case. The source-derived degree function is not the ordinary B38 interpolation.
records.source_layer: Portuguese translation and electronically transcribed Sanskrit BPHS 26.11
critical_limits: The degree-within-sign meaning is distinct from ordinal houses and from the sign-based graha fractions in Saravali.
A modern software reference's Mars 90°–120° formula disagrees with the literal source reconstruction; do not silently use it.
No ancient-case evidence of actual predictive success.

records.locator: Portuguese BPHS CP1252 lines2339–2343; external Sanskrit Chapter26 verse12
records.source_paraphrase: Jupiter uses half the within-sign degree plus forty-five in the third/seventh sign segments and sixty minus double degree in fourth/eighth, then returns to the ordinary rule elsewhere.
records.source_layer: Secondhand Portuguese translated Sanskrit and electronically transcribed BPHS26.12
critical_limits: Under one explicit half-open sign-segment interpolation, around exact 270° the value changes from near-zero on the left to about fifteen on the right when the ordinary rule resumes. This mathematically discontinuous interpretation is tracked, not smoothed.
Other recensions or different boundary rules may resolve it; no manuscript stemma or live engine selection yet.
